review_evidence: Theorem-bearing modules occur under Correctness, FRI/Verified, EGraph/Verified, NTT/Correctness, Plonky3 verification, and bridge components.
These include semantic specs, soundness, transcript and Merkle bridges, translation validation, and NTT correctness.
Formal claims are distributed across core, benchmark, testing, and demo-related paths, so path-name filtering would lose prior-art signal.
summary: Retain AmoLean in full: verified FRI, NTT, e-graph, bridge, benchmark, demo and test paths contain distinct formal specifications and correctness statements.
